problem_restatement: Restore the authority-none V58 continuous research consolidator after its tmux pane remained terminal, without restarting or mutating the armed live backend.

diagnosis.cause: The terminal pane predated the current narrow transient-classification repair. Current source classifies the exact stale-route-status message as concurrent_source_refresh and retries it without replacing valid evidence.
diagnosis.failure_mode_contained: The consolidator is a report-only projection. The armed backend, venue reconciliation, open positions, and protective orders remained independent and healthy.

current_research_state.reason: Actual live capital remains open under the frozen V58 exit contract and this lifecycle had the largest current marked-to-stop giveback in the recovered report.

recommendation: Keep the recovered authority-none consolidator running, continue monitoring its publication freshness independently from backend health, and reconcile the open SP500 and ETH lifecycles after actual resolution. Do not infer strategy edge from the recovery itself.
uncertainties_risks_and_failure_modes: A single bounded success and one survived degraded cycle do not prove indefinite process availability.
Upstream status files can remain stale long enough to delay publication while the process correctly stays alive.
A novel unclassified exception will still terminate the process by design and requires a new diagnosis.
The recovered report is operational evidence, not economic evidence for an entry or exit change.
falsifiers_and_update_conditions: The process exits again on the already-classified exact stale-status message.
A degraded retry replaces the latest valid report with a partial or success-shaped fallback.
Any report declares execution authority, automatic promotion, runtime strategy change, or order support.
The live backend or venue state changes as a consequence of the report-only process.
